Definition: third; feminine a third (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell)
BiblicalUsage: Third is the day, the month, and the part. Jesse begat Shimma the third, Laban heard on the third day that Jacob had fled, and in the third month the people began to lay the foundation of the heaps. Zechariah hears the promise: I will bring the third part through the fire, and refine them as silver is refined.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the third part through the fire is the hope of the whole word. God refines His remnant, and they shall call on His name, and I hold that He hears them.
